column1: # launchd-wall-exempt.tsv (harbor#1442) — a com.harbor.* launchd job allowed to run code from inside the confinement's
# write list. drift-launchd.sh fails on every such path unless a row here covers the job and the path.
# One row per line, three TAB-separated columns: <launchd label> <path or path prefix> <reason>. A row without a reason is
# refused (the check cannot judge). The reason says why the job may run code an agent can edit, and what ends the exemption.
# Core holds none: every core job runs from ~/.claude/bin, which is write-denied. A job that belongs to a workload is
# either moved to an installed copy (the fix) or exempted in the private layer's launchd-wall-exempt.tsv, read after this file.
